P_prediction.text: vis2img predicts imagery activity with broad cortical distribution above a shuffle reference
P_prediction.note: exact null/shuffle metric + figure values not transcribed verbatim this session

D_dimensionality.quote: in early visual areas the number of imagery subspace dimensions was on average slightly less than half the number of visual subspace dimensions

G_alignment.text: imagery subspace explains ~25-30% of visual-subspace variance in V1, ~50% in hV4, approaching ~100% in parietal
G_alignment.definition: total variance in visual activity explained by the dim-dimensional imagery subspace divided by the total variance explained by the first dim dimensions of the visual subspace
